frequency_warning: Pilot counts reflect purposive structural sampling and are not prevalence estimates.

acr_correspondence.rule: Context correspondence and Action correspondence are coded separately. An action-family match without the required Context predicates is not guideline concordance.

bridge_operation_families.name: evidence_to_question_coverage
bridge_operation_families.definition: Interpret what prior evidence has answered relative to the active Q and its requirements.
include: distinguishing study adequacy from test-question capability
exclude: global positive/negative labels with no Q relation
bridge_operation_families.candidate_ai_role: Extract target-level findings, align them to answer requirements, and calculate an auditable coverage table.

bridge_operation_families.name: context_construction_or_remapping
bridge_operation_families.definition: Construct the applicable guideline state from patient predicates, or remap it across variants, stages, sources, or topics as evidence changes.
exclude: choosing an action before Context uncertainty is shown
using cohort diagnosis as the active clinical condition
bridge_operation_families.candidate_ai_role: Retrieve all candidate variants, show supported/missing/conflicting predicates, and abstain when no Context fits.

bridge_operation_families.name: longitudinal_question_transition
bridge_operation_families.definition: Update, advance, reroute, or reopen the clinical question after a prior result or clinical change.
exclude: transition inferred only from the observed order
bridge_operation_families.candidate_ai_role: Track question state and surface why a newly open requirement is consequential.

bridge_operation_families.name: action_realization
bridge_operation_families.definition: Translate an unresolved question and candidate ACR actions into a feasible local test/protocol under patient and modality constraints.
exclude: hiding that the feasible test cannot answer all requirements
bridge_operation_families.candidate_ai_role: Normalize local orders, compare capability and constraints, and expose remaining unanswered requirements.

coexistence_rule: Families are non-exclusive; one decision may require several bridge operations.
next_revision_rule: Recode all pilot cases with B1-B4, retain fine-grained subcodes, and add fresh development cases containing straightforward exact Context matches before freezing.
